items.source: Create a new StandardEnvironment instance with a default MutablePropertySources instance.
items.translation: 创建一个带有默认MutablePropertySources实例的新的StandardEnvironment实例。

items.source: Create a new StandardEnvironment instance with a specific MutablePropertySources instance.
items.translation: 创建一个带有特定MutablePropertySources实例的新的StandardEnvironment实例。

items.source: These default property sources may be removed, reordered, or replaced; and additional property sources may be added using the MutablePropertySources instance available from AbstractEnvironment.getPropertySources(). See ConfigurableEnvironment Javadoc for usage examples.
items.translation: 这些默认属性源可以被移除、重新排序或替换；并且可以使用从 AbstractEnvironment.getPropertySources() 获取的 MutablePropertySources 实例添加额外的属性源。有关使用示例，请参阅 ConfigurableEnvironment Javadoc。

items.source: See SystemEnvironmentPropertySource javadoc for details on special handling of property names in shell environments (for example, Bash) that disallow period characters in variable names.
items.translation: 有关在禁止变量名中包含点字符的 Shell 环境（例如 Bash）中对属性名称的特殊处理，请参阅 SystemEnvironmentPropertySource javadoc。

items.source: Properties present in "systemProperties" will take precedence over those in "systemEnvironment".
items.translation: `"systemProperties"` 中存在的属性将优先于 `"systemEnvironment"` 中的属性。

items.source: Customize the set of property sources with those appropriate for any standard Java environment: "systemProperties" "systemEnvironment"
items.translation: 自定义适用于任何标准 Java 环境的属性源集： "systemProperties" "systemEnvironment"

items.source: JVM system properties property source name: "systemProperties".
items.translation: JVM 系统属性属性源名称："systemProperties"。
